title: codex-captain wrapper always bypasses approvals and sandbox
description: The installed ~/.local/bin/codex-captain wrapper launched an interactive Captain session with default approvals and sandboxing, so every command stalled on a prompt. Add --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox to the wrapper template in scripts/seats/install-captain-seats.mjs and document it in docs/agent-captain-seats.md. Scope is approvals/sandbox only: the wrapper still refuses --dangerously-bypass-hook-trust, since a bypassed run is not evidence the seat hook is trusted.
notes: PR https://github.com/jbongaarts/eshyra/pull/533 open; bead stays in_progress until it merges.
